YYL_STS2_MOD_EVENT_GOLDEN_PIT_EVENT.page:
You move closer. She finally looks up, expressionless, and sets the shovel across her front.

The light is hard to look at. Her grip on the handle is steady - steadier than work requires. The hand still sticks out of the pit, and she is in no hurry to cover it.
Lose nothing and gain 2 card rewards. [red]Requires an upgraded Golden Charm in your deck[/red].
Meet it with [gold]Golden Charm[/gold]
[gold]Lose 60 Gold[/gold], then gain 2 card rewards.
Press some coins on her
[red]Lose 4 HP[/red], then gain 2 card rewards.
Take the shovel
[red]Lose 6 HP[/red], then gain 2 card rewards.
Take the shovel

You raise [gold]Golden Charm[/gold]. Gold spreads from your palm and meets the light in the pit; neither gives ground.

She pauses half a beat, looks at you properly for the first time, then lowers her head and keeps shovelling.

In that half beat you see the whole rhythm of it - the lift, the fall. [gold]You learned a great deal from this girl.[/gold]

At the bottom of the ravine, a golden light is burning with no source at all - too bright for fire, too steady for a lamp.

A girl in odd clothes stands inside it, filling a pit one shovelful at a time. A hand reaches out over the rim, quite still, its knuckles gilded by the light.

"Don't come any closer."

She does not turn, and the shovel does not stop. Only then do you notice: that was not meant for you. It was meant for whatever is under the soil.
Ask what she is burying.
Step closer and ask
Upgrade [gold]Golden Charm[/gold]; if it is already upgraded, enchant it with [gold]Qi Meridian[/gold] instead.
Slip away without a word

You go back the way you came. The gold sinks away behind you, a little lower with every step.

[gold]Golden Charm[/gold] has long since been taken as far as it will go, but the way that light moved is still running through your meridians - [gold]Qi Meridian[/gold] opens.

You go back the way you came. The gold sinks away behind you, a little lower with every step.

It stays in your eyes, though. Somewhere up on the road, the old formula of [gold]Golden Charm[/gold] suddenly falls into place.

You go back the way you came. The gold sinks away behind you, a little lower with every step.

You reach for the charm and remember it is no longer in your deck. You take nothing with you.

You hold out the coins. She takes them, sets them by her foot without counting, and goes back to filling the pit.

You stay a long while. She never thanks you, and never tells you to leave. The gold settles inch by inch over that hand, and something about the way she works finally clicks.

[gold]You learned a great deal from this girl.[/gold]

The flat of the shovel catches your shoulder. It is not a hard blow, but it leaves you entirely awake. She sets the shovel down, never once glancing at the pit, and evens out the soil again.

You stand there holding your shoulder, watching every load land in the same spot, and understand what it means not to hurry.

[gold]You learned a great deal from this girl.[/gold]
YYL_STS2_MOD_EVENT_SNAKE_FLOWER_EVENT.pa:
You raise your foot, and bring it down.

A very small sound, like thin ice breaking.

You glance down. Nothing is left - [red]only a chill you cannot name, creeping from your sole up to your chest.[/red]

In a shaded spot by the road, a flower is quietly blooming.

Its petals are long and coiled like a snake, so tender they are nearly transparent, trembling faintly in the wind - as if breathing, or as if sizing you up.

You have never seen anything like it. Is it a flower, or something else that lives?
Gain a [gold]{CurseCard}[/gold] and a random Uncommon relic.

You hold your breath and cup it in both hands, as if carrying a handful of mist that might scatter at any moment.

The petals brush your palm - cool, soft, and unmistakably moving.

You take it with you. [gold]It seems willing to go.[/gold]
